_note: Key path: transit_planet -> exact_aspect -> natal_target_group. natal_target_group is the short function-group key from _WEEKLY_TARGET_GROUPS in generate.py, not the raw natal target label (see mapping below). Leaves are TODO placeholders for future authored weekly contact meanings -- the meaning_primary rendered field (primary, reader-facing translated prose; technical_label / technical_meta carry the raw astrology separately, see the template hierarchy). Until a leaf is authored, generate.py's _weekly_resolve_or_placeholder() treats a literal "TODO" value as unauthored and transparently falls back to the existing moment_focus.json output, so shipping with TODO leaves is always safe. House context is deliberately NOT a fourth key-path leg here -- it is available as the independent {house_context} interpolation value from house_contexts.json so this file stays a 3D matrix (10 planets x 8 aspects x 15 groups) instead of exploding into a 4D one. natal_target_group source map: identity=Sun -- identity / vitality; mood=Moon -- mood / need / regulation; language=Mercury -- language / decisions; values=Venus -- values / pleasure / exchange; action=Mars -- action / conflict / desire; growth=Jupiter -- growth / scale / belief; structure=Saturn -- structure / accountability; disruption=Uranus -- disruption / freedom; longing=Neptune -- longing / ambiguity; power=Pluto -- power / depth; presence=ASC -- presence / first move; public_role=MC -- public role / vocation; partnership=DSC -- partnership / encounter; home=IC -- home / roots; threshold=Vertex -- threshold / encounter signal

Sun._note: Transit Sun contacts describe visibility, vitality, authorship, attention, and what becomes easier to see.

Conjunction._note: Conjunction should read as a merge or activation point: the transiting energy and the natal target become hard to tell apart for the duration.

Sextile._note: Sextile should read as an available opening that becomes real through participation, not effortless destiny.

Trine._note: Trine should read as natural fluency between the two functions; still worth naming as a specific resource, not vague 'good luck.'

Square._note: Square should read as productive friction between two functions that both want something different; the useful move is adjustment, not a verdict.

Opposition._note: Opposition should read as a tension that needs to be held between two poles rather than resolved by picking one side.

Semisquare._note: Semisquare should read as low-grade friction, an irritant more than a crisis; useful as an early signal.

Sesquiquadrate._note: Sesquiquadrate should read as a secondary adjustment point, often showing up as a nagging correction after an earlier signal was missed.

Quincunx._note: Quincunx should read as a mismatch between two functions that do not naturally relate; the useful move is a deliberate translation, not force.

fallback._note: Fallback for Sun contacts when the exact aspect is not yet authored.
